runs.surface: Design-system-foundation gate follow-up (picis treatment): design-system.css gains a truthful canonical-source-layer provenance header and a real utilities.css import; the 9 prior input-validation defects (including both clinical-safety-critical ones) re-verified fixed on the pinned content
assertions: The design-system-foundation gate gap (`caid frontend-headed-evidence`, design_system: FAIL -- 'lacks canonical source-layer provenance or compiled Symphonix fingerprints' and 'no consumed stylesheet proves the Symphonix base plus healthcare token stack') was confirmed pre-existing and unrelated to this worktree's input-validation edits by re-running the gate with --base-ref origin/main --content-ref origin/main against design-system.css as it stood on origin/main before any edit in this worktree: the same two gaps reproduce. Fixed by adding a truthful provenance header naming the three canonical source layers (colors_and_type.css, healthcare/tokens.css -- vendored flat as healthcare-tokens.css since this repo carries no .claude/skills/symphonix-health-design submodule pin -- and utilities.css) and a real `@import './utilities.css'` of a vendored, byte-identical copy of the design system's own utilities.css. After the fix, `caid frontend-headed-evidence --repo . --base-ref origin/main` reports design_system: PASS.

Login page (http://127.0.0.1:5282/login) rendered correctly after the fix: the .bt-label-required/.bt-label-optional/.bt-error-text markers and the rest of the page's styling are unchanged from before this session's edit (visual_baseline screenshot -01), zero console errors and zero failed requests for the full page-load session.

Spot-check, clinical-safety-critical defect 1 of 2 (medication non-administration reason): signed in as amina.okafor@nursing.test (registered_nurse), opened patient pat-003's Insulin aspart order, set outcome to withheld, entered a whitespace-only reason (three space characters), and clicked Confirm administration record -- POST /api/medication-orders/med-002/administrations still returns 422 (screenshot -02), reconfirming this fix still holds on the pinned design-system.css/utilities.css content.

Spot-check, clinical-safety-critical defect 2 of 2 (harm-incident description): on /incidents, entered a description of five U+200B (zero-width space) characters only and clicked Report as Amina Okafor -- POST /api/patients/pat-001/harm-incidents still returns 422 (screenshot -03), reconfirming this fix still holds on the pinned content.

Console/network across the whole session: the only two console errors and the only two non-2xx network responses are exactly the two expected 422 refusals above (the intended clinical-safety behaviour, not a defect); every other request (fonts, JS modules, /api/auth/login, /api/auth/me, /api/patients/pat-003, /api/ward-board, /api/alerts, /api/wards/ward-med-a/nurses, /api/reference/medication-outcomes, /api/wards/ward-med-a/harm-incidents) returned 200/201/304.

expected_refusals.justification: Spot-check re-proving the whitespace-only-reason fix still holds after the design-system.css/utilities.css edit: a withheld dose whose reason is only spaces must be rejected server-side.
Spot-check re-proving the invisible-Unicode fix still holds after the design-system.css/utilities.css edit: a description made only of zero-width-space characters must be refused as blank.

runs.surface: Login form (missing required markers and enforcement)
assertions: Email and Password labels each carry the bt-label-required class and render a visible red asterisk (confirmed by SignalBox visual_qa against the live screenshot); both inputs carry required and aria-required="true"

Clearing both fields and clicking Sign in produced zero network requests (browser_network, url_pattern=login) -- the previously-missing required attribute now blocks the empty submission natively, before any request is dispatched
Signing in with the seeded demo account amina.okafor@nursing.test / Nursing2026! succeeded with HTTP 200 from POST /api/auth/login (positive control)

runs.surface: Observations vitals form (no required markers, no range mirror of ObservationCreate)
assertions: Respiratory rate, SpO2, Systolic BP, Pulse, Temperature and Consciousness labels all carry bt-label-required, and each input carries required, aria-required="true", type="number", and min/max mirroring the backend ObservationCreate range (respiratory_rate 4-80, oxygen_saturation 50-100, systolic_bp 40-300, pulse 20-250, temperature 30-45)

Entering oxygen_saturation=250 (backend max 100) and clicking Confirm observation produced zero network requests (browser_network, url_pattern=observations) -- refused client-side by the native max constraint before any request was sent
Entering oxygen_saturation=96 and submitting the same form succeeded with HTTP 201 from POST /api/patients/pat-002/observations (positive control)

runs.surface: Safety assessment, SBAR handover, nursing task and care-plan forms (missing required markers/enforcement on App.tsx)
assertions: Safety assessment Findings and Owned action labels carry bt-label-required; clearing both and clicking Save and create action produced zero network requests (previously this form had no required attribute at all and posted straight to the backend); typing valid text and resubmitting succeeded with HTTP 201 from POST /api/patients/pat-002/safety-assessments (positive control)

SBAR Handover situation/background/assessment/recommendation labels carry bt-label-required with required, aria-required="true" and minLength=5 matching HandoverCreate; clearing all four fields and clicking Create pending handover produced zero network requests (previously this form had no required attribute at all)

Create-task Task title enforces minLength=3 matching TaskCreate; a 2-character title ("Hi") produced zero network requests on click Create task; a valid title ("Reposition patient") succeeded with HTTP 201 from POST /api/patients/pat-003/tasks (positive control, screenshot pinned)
Medications administration Reason (shown when outcome is not administered) and Independent co-signer labels carry bt-label-required with required and aria-required="true"

runs.surface: Medications administration record: whitespace-only reason for a non-administered outcome
assertions: Selecting outcome=withheld and entering a reason of three plain spaces, then clicking Confirm administration record, was refused by the backend with HTTP 422 from POST /api/medication-orders/med-003/administrations -- before this fix the identical steps recorded the administration with HTTP 201, i.e. a withheld high-value cardiac medication with no real reason on file
Entering a real reason ("Patient nil by mouth for theatre; dose withheld per medical team instruction.") and resubmitting succeeded with HTTP 201 (positive control)

expected_refusals.justification: proves the whitespace-only-reason fix: a withheld/refused dose whose reason is only spaces must now be rejected server-side instead of being accepted as if it explained the omission
